regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-horse commodity rotation in Canada: Base Metals & Copper leads narrowly over Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.11), both eligible with mean-revert/mixed durability tags, and no theme is crowded despite Technology showing a crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate is validated here (gate_helps true), but cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge on this market's history, so this is a focus/discipline lens only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the narrow 0.11 margin between Base Metals & Copper (leader) and Oil & Gas Producers (challenger) closes within 20 trading days. A confirmed handoff would be Oil & Gas (XEG.TO) holding a rank-1 position for 10 consecutive trading days; if Base Metals recovers its margin to >0.4, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas sits rank 2 with score 1.545, eligible, and the highest durability_bar (0.61) of the commodity leaders. Its hurst_tag is mixed but its breadth of 0.571 is the highest among top ranks, suggesting participation is broader than Base Metals' 0.556. The trend-gate is the one validated risk-control leg, so this is a stay-with-the-leader-adjacent lean rather than a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag 'mixed' and the narrow 0.11 margin to Base Metals mean this is not a confirmed leadership handoff; energy can whip back to base metals quickly on China stimulus headlines, and the detector has no rotation-timing edge.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags XBM.TO by 4% on a 20-day lookback before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is rank 8 with negative score (-0.21), and it is the only crowded theme (crowded=true, crowding_z 1.16). Under the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade; but combined with a negative momentum score and mixed hurst_tag, the discipline suggests avoiding fresh overweight here while the trend-gate is the only validated edge.
theses.dissent: Technology's crowding flag is a caution, not a bear call; a risk-on macro shift could quickly lift growth names, and avoiding a theme with real liquidity risks missing a bounce.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms XBM.TO by 3% over the next 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Fertilizer, Chemicals & Forestry
theses.thesis: This Materials sub-theme is rank 7 with a negative score (-0.043) and is not eligible (eligible=false). Durability_bar is low at 0.31 and breadth is only 0.375, indicating weak, narrow participation. With the trend-gate as the one validated edge, this is a textbook underweight candidate for de-risking.
theses.dissent: Fertilizer can spike on a single supply-shock headline (potash/ag cycle), and the negative score is mild; underweighting a theme with occasional sharp upside risks whipsaw in a mean-reverting regime.

falsifier.text: XMA.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by 2% over the next 20 trading days.
